events.context: User provides text for extraction, which is a research paper abstract and sections on AI governance framework
System extracts key actions and decisions from the text, focusing on the proposed framework and its components
Author proposes a legal mechanism adapting corporate veil-piercing doctrine to AI governance, with trade secret protection for developers in exchange for ethical ledgers
Author identifies three veil-piercing triggers: autonomy-control conflation, profit-driven manipulation, and performative alignment
Author analyzes existing AI governance approaches and explains how the framework differs, focusing on governance vs. liability, no AI personhood required, and conditional trade secret protection

Author designs a constitutional framework with deliberate fuzzy space (trade secret protection), ethical ledgers, and a three-tier accountability structure (company self-regulation, statutory oversight board, judicial oversight)
Author defines the three veil-piercing triggers with mapping to existing law and potential evidentiary indicators
Author provides case studies (hypothetical and real incidents) to demonstrate how veil-piercing triggers would operate in practice
Author concludes by discussing three-way relationship dynamics among company, user, and government under the framework
